keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Ilane Touré (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Noah Markmann (Nordsjælland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Monaco 1, Nordsjælland 0. Mathys Detourbet (Monaco) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Takumi Minamino.
First Half ends, Monaco 1, Nordsjælland 0.
Second Half begins Monaco 1, Nordsjælland 0.
Substitution, Monaco. Vanderson replaces Ilane Touré.
Substitution, Monaco. Sadibou Sané replaces Eric Dier.
Substitution, Monaco. Aleksandr Golovin replaces Edan Diop.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Ibrahim Adel replaces Villum Berthelsen.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Prince Amoako replaces Mamadou Sadio.
Victor Nelsson (Nordsjælland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Monaco. Mamadou Coulibaly replaces Paris Brunner.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Hjalte Boe Rasmussen replaces Ola Solbakken.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Runar Norheim replaces Markus Walker.
Substitution, Monaco. Matthis Abline replaces Folarin Balogun.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Nicklas Røjkjær replaces Malte Heyde.
Goal! Monaco 2, Nordsjælland 0. Matthis Abline (Monaco) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mathys Detourbet following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Mathys Detourbet (Monaco).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Monaco 2, Nordsjælland 0.
